primitives.name: Data Coverage Integrity
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Brutal audit - CRITICAL: active, legally usable data coverage remains smaller than the seeded source universe.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C_{\\text{legal}}': 'dimensionless, legal usability indicator', 'C_{\\text{seeded}}': 'dimensionless, seeded source universe size', 'C_{\\text{active}}': 'dimensionless, active data coverage'}
primitives.assumptions: Legal coverage is a subset of seeded universe; active coverage is a subset of legal.

layer2.mapping: Bayesian posterior over $ P(C_{\text{legal}} | C_{\text{seeded}}) $ maps to GSI's trust score.
layer2.telemetry: Ratio of active legal data to seeded universe.

primitives.name: Trust Explanation Layer
primitives.verbatim_quote: - HIGH: premium UX must explain trust, coverage, conflicts, and missing data in ten seconds.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T_{\\text{trust}}': 'dimensionless, trust score', 'M_{\\text{missing}}': 'count, missing data points', 'C_{\\text{conflict}}': 'count, conflicting data entries'}
primitives.assumptions: Trust is inversely proportional to missing and conflicting data.

layer2.mapping: Kernel-based aggregation of $ T_{\text{trust}}, M_{\text{missing}}, C_{\text{conflict}} $ into GSE's explanation vector.
layer2.telemetry: Time to render trust summary in UI.

The core duality lies between legal data coverage and active data usage. The system operates under a Bayesian lens where trust is updated based on evidence from source integrity, freshness, and conflict resolution. The UX layer must compress this into a 10-second narrative, which implies a kernel-based reduction of high-dimensional data into interpretable signals. The licensed route primitive ensures that high-value metrics like pressure and grades are only available when contractual agreements are in place, enforcing a dual regime of access control and data quality. Failure modes include trust erosion due to missing or conflicting data, leading to reduced user engagement and model degradation. The system must maintain a balance between data richness and interpretability through structured telemetry.
